source.title: Specular Rainbowfish — firsthand Wowhead comment on milling
source.author: Golgoth

notes: NEW first-person TWW processing identity not present in indexed original research: commenter says a Specular Rainbowfish can be milled by Scribes and reports receiving three Nacreous Pigment. Source does not explicitly state completed operation count, fish consumed per operation, pigment quality-rank/item ID, skill, specialization, Resourcefulness, build, patch/hotfix, output-hit denominator, or any zero outcomes; all remain null. This is an undated single anecdote, not a rank-specific Mycobloom 10-herb mill result or statistical estimate. Input item identity 220141 verified from the Wowhead item page; Warcraft Wiki Nacreous Pigment page independently identifies Specular Rainbowfish as a possible source, not the observed pigment quality. No inferred per-cast chance/average. Secondary identity context: https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Nacreous_Pigment and https://www.wowhead.com/spell=444181/khaz-algar-milling .
